figurative_meaning_en: immediately, right then, specific time, designated time, at that time
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘটনার তৎকালে সবাই চুপ করে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He made the decision right then.
Everyone fell silent at that very moment.
note: These are more adverbial expressions than full idioms, rooted in classical Bengali influenced by Sanskrit.
